tasks.title: Keep Party grids and disclosure actions bounded with enlarged text
tasks.body:
Goal:
Bound Party summary and member grids with enlarged text.

Current behavior:
Current rendered evidence records 592-pixel document width in a 360-pixel viewport at 200-percent text. The summary grid has an unconditional 18-rem minimum. Member action minimum width can also exceed card content; fixed desktop member columns must adapt to available text width.

Desired behavior:
Use available-width-bounded minimums and responsive member columns. Keep public record context readable, preserve complete content and existing native details behavior.

Touch:
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-game-names-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-party-reflow-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-adapters.json`

Implementation constraints:
No hidden overflow, smaller text, removed actions, new command, provider mutation or preference change. Existing local synthetic build/test authorization applies. Physical devices and assistive technology remain unqualified.

Validation:
Retain the original failing rendered receipt, full real Party fixtures and native disclosure/focus journey. Check the complete required matrix and ordinary-word name width rather than accepting glyph-wide columns.
